theme: Dark Mode (Swiss Brutalist meets Tech Futurism)

headings.style: Bold, geometric, tracking-tighter for h1/h2, uppercase for overlines with tracking-widest.

layouts_and_grids.hero: Full viewport height. Massive kinetic text dominating the center. Background features an abstract particle or wavy metallic texture tinted dark. Navigation sticky at top.
layouts_and_grids.services_bento: Bento grid layout (Mode A). Mix of tall, wide, and square cards. 1px solid borders (border-white/10) with dark gradients.
layouts_and_grids.team_grid: Grid cols-2 md:cols-3. Images in grayscale with high contrast, revealing color or scaling up on hover.
layouts_and_grids.footer: Multi-column layout. Massive brand name at the bottom. Minimalistic lines.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for the hero text. Use framer-motion (clip-path or overflow-hidden on wrapper, animate y-transform).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Apply subtle y-axis parallax to images in the 'Journey' and 'Services' sections using framer-motion useScroll.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for the 'Power for SMEs' tags, large outlined text.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements should have a slight scale down (0.98) or scale up (1.02), border color shift to accent (#E63946), and text color brightening.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for the sticky nav. backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Apply a subtle SVG noise overlay across the entire site to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.lines_and_borders: Embrace 1px borders. Use them to construct the grid visually (e.g., separating sections and columns).

media_and_assets.icons: Use lucide-react for abstract tech icons. Minimal, 1px stroke weight where possible.
media_and_assets.image_instructions: For client logos, apply CSS filter: grayscale(100%) brightness(200%) to make them pure white. For team members, use object-cover, high contrast grayscale by default, transitioning to color on hover.

components_strategy.ui_library: Use Shadcn UI for forms, inputs, and buttons. Heavy custom styling to match the dark brutalist theme.
components_strategy.custom_sections: Hero, Services Bento Grid, Journey Timeline, and Team Grid should be built with raw Tailwind divs for maximum layout flexibility.
components_strategy.google_map: Embed an actual iframe for the Google Map in the Contact section, with CSS filter to invert or dark mode styling (filter: invert(90%) hue-rotate(180deg) contrast(80%)).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Stick to 'Outfit'.
Avoid standard Bootstrap-style columns. Embrace asymmetry and generous padding (p-12 to p-32).
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in App.js or main entry point.
Use Framer Motion extensively for scroll reveals and the kinetic hero.
Never use pure black for cards; use the elevated surface colors.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Always use the provided URLs.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Off-white text on dark background achieves excellent contrast.
accessibility.focus_states: All focus states must be visible, using the accent crimson color as a ring.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling heavy framer-motion animations.
